image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a male mallard duck (drake) resting on what appears to be a wooden surface or log. The duck features the characteristic iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey/brown body plumage. Its yellow bill is prominent in the foreground, showing distinct black markings (saddle and nail). The background consists of blurred vegetation and wood textures.
